provenance.catalogue: Gaia DR3 astrometry/photometry + Bailer-Jones et al.2021 EDR3 geometric distances
provenance.credit: ESA/Gaia/DPAC; Bailer-Jones, Rybizki, Fouesneau, Demleitner and Andrae (2021); GAVO
provenance.query: SELECT TOP 50000 source_id,ra,dec,pmra,pmdec,parallax,parallax_error,phot_g_mean_mag,phot_bp_mean_mag,phot_rp_mean_mag,ruwe FROM gaia.dr3lite WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',270.76531645904527,-24.30622861770443,2.5934547218663964)) AND phot_g_mean_mag<12 AND ruwe<1.4 AND parallax>5*parallax_error
provenance.radiusSelection: Explicit physical neighbourhood radius selected for the displayed surrounding field; independent of image or cloud bounds.

acquisitions.query: SELECT TOP 50000 source_id,ra,dec,pmra,pmdec,parallax,parallax_error,phot_g_mean_mag,phot_bp_mean_mag,phot_rp_mean_mag,ruwe FROM gaia.dr3lite WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',270.76531645904527,-24.30622861770443,2.5934547218663964)) AND phot_g_mean_mag<12 AND ruwe<1.4 AND parallax>5*parallax_error

provenance.selection: Authored spherical neighbourhood with radial taper. RUWE<1.4 and parallax/error>5; qualified Gaia cone query without archive sorting, then exact source-id Bailer-Jones lookups, local physical-sphere filtering and brightness sorting. Reaching the 50000-candidate cap is an error, so published inputs preserve the complete query selection. Distance medians and 16/84 percentiles retained; no cluster membership inferred.
